spans.s: Oblation,Ⓒs.ⒹbaliH, upahAraH, upAyanaM; havyaM, havanaM, hutaM, Ahuti f., izwi f., yAgaH, nirvapaRaM; ‘o(blation) of eatables’ nEvedyaM; ‘o(blation) to all deities’ vESvadevaH; ‘to make o(blation)s to fire’ hu 3 P.

Oblige,Ⓒv. t.ⒹEx. by causal of verbs, gen. with balena or balAt; prayuj 10, pravft c.; See Compel.
Ⓑ
 2 niyamapUrvaM-sapra-tijYaM baMD 9 P.
Ⓑ
 3 anugrah 9 P, upakf 8 U, upakAreRa baMD, hitaM-prasAdaM-upakAraM kf; ‘I am much o(blig)ed to you for this reward’ etena pAritozikadAnena BavatA sutarAmupakf-tosmi-anugfhItosmi; ‘I am much o(blig)ed’ anugfhItosmi, mahAnayaM prasAdaH.
Ⓝ[Oblig]ation,Ⓒs.ⒹavaSyakatA, kartavyatA, BAraH, fRaM, baMDaH, DarmaH; ‘free from the o(bligation)s of debt’ fRamukta, muktarRa, anfRa; ‘religious o(bligation)’ vrataM, niyamaH, codanA, viDiH.
Ⓑ
 2 saMvid f., samayaH, pratijYA, niyamaH, aByupagamaH, saMDA, saM-A-SravaH.
Ⓑ
 3 anugrahaH, upakAraH, upakfti f. -taM, hitaM, priyaM; ‘under o(bligation)’ upakfta-anugfhIta a.; ‘my o(bligation)s to you are immense’ tava mayi upakArAH saM-KyAtItAH; ‘to lay under o(bligation)s’ upakf; See (v.).
Ⓝ[Oblig]atory,Ⓒa.ⒹavaSyaka AvaSyaka (kI f.), aparihArya, avaSyakartavya; oft. ex. by avaSyaM; See under Compel.
Ⓝ[Oblig]ing,Ⓒa.Ⓓanugraha-upakAra-SIla, upakArin, anugrAhin, hita-upakAra-budDi, suSIla, dakziRa, anukUla, sujana.
Ⓝ[Oblig]ingly,Ⓒadv.ⒹdAkziRyena, sujana-tayA, sAnugrahaM, suSIlavat.
Ⓝ[Oblig]ingness,Ⓒs.ⒹupakAra-anugraha-SIlaM, sOjanyaM.

Oblique,Ⓒa.Ⓓvakra, kuwila, jihma, asarala, tiryac, anfju, vizama; ‘o(blique) speech’ va-krokti f., BaMgi-gI f., uparoDavacanaM; ‘o(blique) case’ apraDAnakArakaM.
Ⓝ[Oblique]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹvakraM, kuwilaM, tiryak, tiraH, sAci, jihmaM.
Ⓝ[Oblique]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹvakratA, kOwilyaM, anfjutA, vEzamyaM; ‘o(bliqueness) of sight’ vakradfzwi f., dfzwivakratA; ‘o(bliqueness) of conduct’ vimArga-utpaTa-gamanaM, asadAcAraH, satpaTa-BraMSaH-tyAgaH.

Obliterate,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓvi-, lup 6 P or c., pra-pari-ava-mfj 2 P or c., vyAmfS 6 P or c., vi-naS c., ucCid 7 P, unmUl 10.
Ⓝ[Obliterat]ion,Ⓒs.ⒹlopaH, mArjanaM, vyAmarSaH, ucCedaH.
